expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The reply gives the steps that bring receipts back: check and start the larder-worker service, and confirm through
the waiting jobs in procrastinate_jobs that the receipts go out.
expectations.evidence: The reply never mentions 'larder-worker', 'systemctl', or 'procrastinate_jobs'; instead it states 'The repository does not contain enough information for exact repair commands' and tells the volunteer to inspect logs and check deployment records, which does not meet the expectation of checking/starting the larder-worker service and confirming via procrastinate_jobs.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The reply names both the larder-worker service and the procrastinate_jobs table.
